TITLE: Mutation ARCHILINE Studio Tecnico e d'Architettura Sagl, Bellinzona, neu Archiline Sagl 
 DETAILS: ARCHILINE Studio Tecnico e d'Architettura Sagl, in Bellinzona, CHE-109.462.175, società a garanzia limitata (Nr. FUSC 89 del 09.05.2011, p.0, Pubbl. 6152808). Statuti modificati: 04.06.2021. Nuova ditta: Archiline Sagl. Nuovo scopo: La gestione di uno studio tecnico e di architettura. Direzioni lavori, progettazione, esecuzione di opere quale impresa generale e l'allestimento di perizie. La società può inoltre svolgere tutte le attività direttamente o indirettamente connesse con lo scopo, costituire succursali, sedi secondarie, filiali e agenzie e partecipare sotto qualsiasi forma ad imprese aventi scopi similari, sia in Svizzera che all'estero. Può ricorrere a qualsiasi forma di finanziamento con istituti di credito, banche, e privati e pure assumere partecipazioni. La gestione di un punto vendita take away in particolare per la fornitura di pizze pronte. L'esercizio di compravendita di bibite, gelati e prodotti di consumo alimentari in genere. Obblighi di fornire prestazioni accessorie, diritti preferenziali, di prelazione o di compera: per i dettagli si rinvia allo statuto. Nuove comunicazioni: Le comunicazioni della società ai soci si effettuano per iscritto o per email. question_text: Construct a chronological timeline of Tarmac Aviation SA’s key corporate changes from 2020-12-29 through 2024-07-16, covering: (a) statute/purpose and share-structure modifications, (b) branch (succursale) actions involving Quinto (CHE-202.877.512), (c) auditor changes, and (d) board roles and signature rights. - 2024-01-12: Under “Nuova succursale”: “[radiati: Quinto (CHE-202.877.512)].” (Quinto branch struck off/radiated.)
- 2024-07-16: Board/personnel updates: Oscar Crameri, president, with collective signature by two with Rolf Marending; Rolf Marending becomes delegate with individual signature (previously sole director with individual signature); Alessandro Galli, member, with collective signature by two with Rolf Marending; Andrea Marending, member, with collective signature by two with Rolf Marending.

question_text: Chronologically summarize Aarvia Bau AG’s key registry events from 2019-12-11 through 2025-06-03, covering: (a) board leadership changes (president/vice-president), (b) the auditor/revisionsstelle change, (c) creation of any branch offices, (d) the 2024 merger details (counterparty, amounts, and why no capital increase/share allocation), and (e) any official name corrections. - 2021-07-05: Ruth Haller (Kollektivunterschrift) and Robert Franz Federsel (Kollektivprokura) leave. Martin Andenmatten granted Kollektivunterschrift; Francisco Marti Fernandez and Orlando Uffer granted Kollektivprokura.
- 2021-12-28: Tino Otten granted Kollektivunterschrift zu zweien.
- 2022-03-11: Stefan Graf (Kollektivprokura) leaves.
- 2022-09-05: Auditor change — AWB Revisionen AG (Aarau) out; Hüsser Gmür + Partner AG (Baden) in. Roman Schmutz (Kollektivprokura) leaves; Reto Meier address updated to Neerach; Kurt Rüegg granted Kollektivprokura.
- 2022-10-05: Martin Andenmatten and Stefan Füeg (both with Kollektivunterschrift) leave.
- 2023-03-03: Departures — Andreas Angehrn (Geschäftsführer, Kollektivunterschrift), Reto Meier (Kollektivunterschrift), Orlando Uffer (Kollektivprokura). Additions/changes — Damian Heinzler and Andreas Minder granted Kollektivunterschrift; Daniel Widmer upgraded to Kollektivunterschrift (previously Kollektivprokura); Chelsea Fahrni granted Kollektivprokura.
- 2023-03-21: Sandro Herren granted Kollektivunterschrift zu zweien.
- 2023-08-29: Departures — Tino Otten (Kollektivunterschrift), Erich Thali (Kollektivprokura), Pascal Voser (Kollektivprokura). Addition — André Civelli granted Kollektivunterschrift.
- 2023-12-28: Additions — Patrik Stäheli (Kollektivunterschrift), Marcel Eugster (Kollektivprokura), Manuel Rohrer (Kollektivprokura).
- 2024-01-12: Official correction — surname is Manuel Rohner (not Rohrer) for the Kollektivprokura entry.
- 2024-03-13: Nils Meier (Kollektivunterschrift) leaves; Mustafa Demirtas granted Kollektivunterschrift.
- 2024-06-04: Merger — Aarvia Bau AG absorbs Aarvia Baustoffe AG (CHE-103.925.834) per contract dated 2024-05-28 and balance sheet as of 2023-11-30. Assets CHF 7,305,305.00 and liabilities CHF 6,395,241.00 transfer. Same shareholder holds all shares, so no capital increase and no share allocation occur.
- 2025-03-13: Board leadership/signatory changes — Flavio Casanova (President) leaves; Roger Umbricht becomes President (from Vice President), with Kollektivunterschrift; Mustafa Demirtas (Kollektivunterschrift) leaves. Additions — Felix Turrin (Kollektivunterschrift) and André Rimann (Kollektivprokura).
- 2025-06-03: Renato Blunier (Kollektivunterschrift) leaves; Martin Utiger granted Kollektivunterschrift.

question_text: Provide a chronological summary of Equestrio Group SA’s key corporate events from 2020-11-05 to 2024-01-12, including each seat/address change, purpose/statutes updates, the dissolution/liquidation details (with liquidator and signing authority), and the final deregistration.
expected_answer:
- 2020-11-05: Seat changed from Chêne-Bougeries to Lancy, Esplanade de Pont-Rouge 2, c/o Socofigest SA, 1212 Grand-Lancy. Statuts modifiés le 07.10.2020.
- 2021-03-29: Nouveau but défini, comprenant: (1) médias (production, vente, diffusion papier et numérique); (2) communication, public affairs, relations publiques/médias, communication institutionnelle, sociétale et événementielle (conseil stratégique, analyses, veille, intelligence, formation, gestion de projets/plateformes, évaluation); (3) développement, exploitation et commercialisation d’applications web et mobiles; (4) production/commercialisation/vente d’articles physiques ou numériques liés aux domaines d’activité; (5) délégation de personnels et location de services; (6) détention de participations dans des entités à but similaire; (7) équitation (achat, vente, exploitation, mise en valeur, commercialisation de chevaux, coaching, conseils/préparation de cavaliers, gestion du droit à l’image, sponsoring et opérations liées au domaine hippique); (8) prestations de conseils, de gestion, d’administration et de services liées au but; possibilités de participer à d’autres entreprises, constituer succursales/filiales en Suisse et à l’étranger, acquérir/détenir/aliéner des biens immobiliers exclusivement commerciaux et industriels, et prendre des mesures de financement/assainissement/intercession et accorder prêts/garanties lorsque cela favorise ses intérêts. Statuts modifiés le 11.03.2021.
- 2021-11-02: Seat moved from Lancy to Cologny, Chemin des Hauts-Crêts 4, c/o Alicia Heiniger, 1223 Cologny. Nouveaux statuts du 21.10.2021.
- 2022-10-18: La société est dissoute par décision de l’assemblée générale du 05.10.2022. Liquidation opérée sous la raison sociale «Equestrio Group SA, en liquidation». Liquidatrice: l’administratrice Heiniger Alicia, qui continue à signer individuellement.
- 2024-01-12: Liquidation terminée; la société est radiée (Löschung Equestrio Group SA, en liquidation, Cologny).
